title: Jehoshaphat and the Victory of Praise
description: King Jehoshaphat faces an overwhelming enemy army from Moab, Ammon, and the mountains of Seir, but instead of fighting, he sends praise leaders ahead of his troops, and the Lord defeats the enemies without Judah having to fight.
